violation_type.title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests
violation_type.typical_finding: 1 out of 10 caregivers needs to complete pediatric CPR/ 1st Aid, not training for adults only and make the certificate available.

finding_variants.text: 1 out of 10 caregivers needs to complete pediatric CPR/ 1st Aid, not training for adults only and make the certificate available.
A caregiver with unsupervised access to children did not have a copy of their first aid card on file. The caregiver has completed the training, but the first aid card was not available to review.
A copy of the directors CPR and First Aid training certificate was not available for review during the inspection.
Three caregivers did not have copy of CPR/First Aid certificates available at inspection.
The director did not have pediatric CPR and First Aid training available.

Two staff observed in the classroom in the role as a caregiver did not have a CPR/First-Aid certification available for review on file.  One staff in the infant classroom and one staff observed in the Discover's classroom did not have any form of certification available for Licensing to review.
